coreRepoPath.description: Optional local, read-only checkout of the NGO.Core source repository (see config/core-repository.yaml). When present, enables the ingest-core-release skill to derive version knowledge from git tags/diffs instead of relying solely on hand-authored knowledge/canonical/versions/*.json.

coreReleaseNotesPath.description: Optional path to the shared release-notes.md (external to the NGO.Core repo's own history; shared with the frontend track). Combined with coreRepoPath by ingest-core-release.
